message.content: The largest planet that astronomers have confirmed so far is the exoplanet **HD 100546 b**. It orbits the young star HD 100546 and has a mass of roughly 15–17 Jupiter masses and a radius about 2.5 times that of Jupiter. This makes it the biggest planet we’ve found in our current catalog of extrasolar planets.
